{{Quote|Take a Cosmic Chance on a rich, flavorful slider inspired by the one and only Gambler's World. Our regular patty is topped with sautéed Vorzydiak mushrooms and three kibi strips. If you're craving something exciting, this is a safe bet.|The description of the slider on the menu|<ref name="Dex" />}}
A '''Kibi strip''' was a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]]. Three kibi strips were used in the [[Vorzyd slider/Legends|Vorzyd slider]] served in the [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kibi strips were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dex" />
